knowledgeBase.question: What is your refund and cancellation policy?
knowledgeBase.answer: All monthly and annual plans include a 14-day full money-back guarantee. You can cancel or switch tiers anytime from your billing dashboard with zero cancellation fees.

knowledgeBase.question: How does WebOrient handle sensitive user data like passwords or credit cards?
knowledgeBase.answer: WebOrient automatically masks and ignores password fields, credit card inputs, and elements tagged with data-agent-ignore. All audio and tool calls pass through an encrypted gateway relay without exposing API keys.

knowledgeBase.question: Does WebOrient work with React, Next.js, Vue, and plain HTML?
knowledgeBase.answer: Yes. WebOrient is a zero-dependency drop-in ES module that dispatches native prototype value setters and synthetic Pointer/Input events compatible with React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and static sites.
